summary: Alice & Bob joined QuBriC as an industry partner to support doctoral research and training in quantum error correction.
quote: PARIS, Aug. 12, 2026 — Alice & Bob, a leader in fault-tolerant quantum computing, is contributing its expertise in cat-qubit error correction to QuBriC, Europe’s first Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network dedicated to quantum error correction (QEC).
